interpretation: All completed outputs are syntactically coherent and stay on the assigned task; no observed cross-task topic contamination. This is not a complete answer-quality evaluation: all outputs are intentionally cut at256 tokens, and wording includes ordinary model mistakes.

B1 cold/restored outputs diverge reproducibly at token17 despite matched payloads; cold repeats are identical while warm continuations vary. The completed baseline control reproduces this and it remains a cache-path/numerical behavior observation. Do not dismiss as thermal timing or automatically claim corruption.
B4 offered concurrency is matched, but admission order and active batch composition can differ. Pairwise exact equality is useful additional evidence, not a guaranteed batch-invariance contract.

This task mix has materially lower speculative acceptance than synthetic document continuation, so its throughput findings apply to different token trajectories. Cold/warm throughput deltas combine saved prefill with changed generated sequences and proposal acceptance.
Complete baseline control reproduces the salient B1 divergence, proving this particular behavior predates the refresh. Exact numerical cause remains unproven.
Both arms have verified RAM restores and valid output accounting. Different generated token paths/acceptance can contribute to timing differences; compare cold and warm separately.

qualitative_notes.implementation: Cold and warm both discuss token buckets/fairness/cancellation; they choose different outline wording. Warm prose includes a debatable queue-jumping fairness claim; neither256-token excerpt reaches the promised complete implementation/tests.
qualitative_notes.debugging: Outputs discuss threading, expiration iteration, clock and LRU replacement. Claims about DST affecting Unix timestamps and labeling every deletion-during-iteration case undefined behavior are inaccurate/model-level wording issues, not cache-corruption evidence.
qualitative_notes.database: Outputs discuss booking/check-then-act failures, but at least one excerpt overgeneralizes phantom reads and an atomic decrement example; do not score these as verified SQL guidance.
qualitative_notes.planning: Outputs stay on deployment validation. Both use generic nvidia-smi examples despite no GPU vendor in the fixture; no task contamination inferred.

mutations: Review JSON only; no HTTP/GPU/server/service execution.

matched_configuration_review.capacity_note: Parent reports stable cached-start baseline4.84GiB/149888 attention tokens and candidate4.95GiB/159104. Different capacity is an observed package effect under the same utilization budget, not an unmatched explicit block override.

resources.note: 5-second samples restricted to first measured request through last completed response, including gaps between waves. RSS sums include shared pages and are not physical-RAM usage; DRM client IDs deduplicated. Observed sample peaks are not instantaneous maxima.

conclusion: Both completed chat matrices have30 valid requests and verified RAM restore evidence. Candidate median aggregate throughput is within2% of baseline in all four cells, descriptively. The B1 cold/restored token17 branch is inherited and cold outputs match exactly across releases; restored/B4 paths have output variation. No broad statistical equivalence, model-quality, throttle-free or universal TTFT improvement claim is supported.

performance_interpretation.aggregate_throughput: Candidate median aggregate output throughput is within2% of baseline in every completed chat cell: B1 cold -0.94%, B1 restored -1.60%, B4 cold -0.70%, B4 restored -0.02%. Descriptively similar on this small task mix; not a statistical equivalence claim.
performance_interpretation.decode: Cold B1 uses identical output tokens across releases and median decode rate differs -0.76%. Restored B1 differs -3.22%, but token trajectories and proposal acceptance differ.
performance_interpretation.ttft: Cold B4 median TTFT is11.34% lower for candidate, while admission order/output mix vary. Avoid promoting this small-sample schedule-sensitive result as a general latency gain. Other chat median TTFT differences are below2%.
performance_interpretation.preemptions: Candidate has2 actual preemptions in the measured chat matrix; baseline0. Requests still complete and throughput is similar. Preserve as a scheduler-behavior observation for follow-up rather than omitting it.
performance_interpretation.resources: Both arms report2800MHz in all30 samples, zero process swap, and intermittent throttle flags. The flag is not enough to identify its cause; do not claim throttle-free testing.5-second sampling and arm order limit causal attribution.
